questiontext.text:
Find the size of angle \(\angle BCA\) in the diagram below

[[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard('jxgbox', { boundingbox: [-8, 12, 16, -5], keepAspectRatio: false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false, axis: false }); const A = board.create('point', [-1, -1], { name: 'A', size: 2, fixed: true }); const B = board.create('point', [-5,10], { name: 'B', size: 2, fixed: true }); const C = board.create('point', [12,5], { name: 'C', size: 2, fixed: true }); /* Put angle text labels */ board.create('text', [0, 0.5, '{#A#}°'], {fontSize: 12}); board.create('text', [-4, 9, '{#B#}°'], {fontSize: 12}); board.create('text', [10, 5,' '], {fontSize: 12}); // Angle at C (between points B-C-A) board.create('angle', [B, C, A], { radius: 1, name: ' ', type: 'sector', orthoSensitivity: false, fillColor: 'lightblue', strokeColor: 'blue' }); // Angle at B (between points A-B-C) board.create('angle', [A, B, C], { radius: 1, name: ' ',type: 'sector', orthoSensitivity: false, fillColor: 'lightgreen', strokeColor: 'green' }); // Angle at A (between rays AB and AC) board.create('angle', [C, A, B], { radius: 1, name: ' ', type: 'sector', fillColor: 'lightblue', strokeColor: 'blue' }); board.create('polygon', [A,B,C], { borders: { strokeWidth: 1, strokeColor: 'blue' }, fillColor: 'none' }); [[/jsxgraph]]

\(\angle BCA = \) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

Recall that the sum of the interior angles in any triangle is 180°.

From the question, the angles need to add upto 180°:

\( {@A@}+{@B@}+ x = 180° \)

\( x = 180°- {@A+B@} \)

\( x= {@C@}\)

questionnote.text:
Worked solution

We are finding the hypotenuse {@letters@} of a right-angled triangle.

Angle 1: {@A@}

Angle 2: {@B@}

Angle 3: {@C@}

sum : {@A+B+C@}
